name: Tenjiku Amane
source:
"If I catch an octopus...... Takoyaki, can you make it?"

Likes: Military, muscle

A tourist girl who comes from the city.

Due to certain circumstances, she was banned from entering the shopping district and restaurant​s. Unable to endure her hunger, she went looking for food at [url=/c113574]Kyouhei[/url]'s house. She got caught and was mistaken for a burglar.

After that, the misunderstanding was cleared, and since then, the two of them got acquainted and go sightseeing in the town together. She is very fond of B-grade gourmet food, especially, yakisoba, takoyaki, etc.

A narcissistic, prideful, and go her own way type, often treats Kyouhei with her high-handed attitude as well, but on the other hand, she also has a surprising​ side, such as becoming weak when she feels pressured.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/samenana/character/amane.html]Official website[/url]]
